principle: Primary official disclosure/economic source first; wrappers and commercial portals may be used only as non-authoritative diagnostics or cross-checks.

requirements: raw response or original filing bytes must be hashed
report period must be stored separately from publication availability
corrections/restatements must be separate immutable revisions
third-party wrappers cannot establish publication availability
commercial finance portals cannot be the authoritative value source

INDUSTRY.primary_rule: Use the original government, exchange, association, commodity-exchange, customs or company source that owns the observation. Source authority is dataset-specific and must be declared before ingestion.

EVENT_SURPRISE.primary_rule: Actual event must come from the original official issuer/source. Expectation must be separately timestamped and already public before the actual event; otherwise no surprise feature is permitted.
